race.comment: SHE'S BUOYANT (12) resumes. She looked good winning on debut at Geelong as a $12 chance, racing near the pace in a small field and coming away to score by a length. She can be improved this time around and maps nicely again. With a few dangers coming out she's clearly the one to beat. MARGIN CALL (3) is knocking on the door with back to back placings, just missing at Pakenham Synthetic last start. He maps well and should go close. ENDLESS FOREVERS (11) is down in grade after struggling at Bendigo but was in the market there and can bounce back off solid prior form. PANTOJA (7) beat in an-form horse at Bairnsdale last time and can measure up nicely here.
